verdict.rationale: Attio ships people and companies as default objects and links objects through its graph model, so contacts and companies are managed as related records. Marketing pages also claim 'full history of every interaction', with calls automatically logged. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the per-record activity timeline (which activity types appear, emails/meetings/notes), explicit docs on how person–company relationships are set up, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
